overview.text: Today's artificial intelligence developments highlight crucial advancements across model training, agent reliability, and hardware deployment. A comprehensive new video course details reasoning models from the ground up, covering inference-time scaling, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. In research, new frameworks such as Trial by Trace benchmark AI agent harnesses for reliability and failure attribution, while Trajectory2Gym addresses decision-grounded compositional interaction synthesis for tool-use agents. Scientific discovery frameworks like Principia build test-time hypotheses to principle construction, and On-Policy Self-Training enables data-free self-improvement in large language models. Meanwhile, major releases and updates include Comfy-Org/Fibo-2.0, native macOS app creation agents, and Android local deployment tools. Industry labs and analyses feature OpenAI integrations utilizing GPT-6 Astra, Fanatics deployments improving fan engagement, and evaluations of frontier models handling real-world tasks. Additionally, hardware developments examine Amazon's Trainium expanding its capabilities from inference to training.

entries.title: Building Reasoning Models from the Ground Up: A Full Video Course
entries.summary: Over 11 hours of coding videos on evaluation, inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning, and distillation, with Python and PyTorch.
entries.why: Provides practical coding videos on reasoning models, inference scaling, and reinforcement learning using Python and PyTorch.

entries.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
entries.summary: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation.
entries.why: Establishes benchmarks for evaluating AI agent harness reliability and attributing failures accurately.

entries.title: Principia: Test-Time Hypotheses to Principle Construction for Scientific Discovery
entries.summary: Scientific discovery requires identifying the scientific principles underlying observed phenomena to guide further investigation.
entries.why: Advances scientific discovery by constructing principles from test-time hypotheses to guide investigations.

entries.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
entries.summary: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time.
entries.why: Synthesizes compositional interactions to improve tool-use agents beyond standard successful trajectories.

entries.title: DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
entries.summary: The rapid growth of microdramas has increased demand for high-quality script production. Long-form microdrama script generation with LLMs requires both diverse plot progression and long-range narrative coherence.
entries.why: Improves long-range narrative coherence and plot progression for multi-agent microdrama script generation pipelines.

entries.title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
entries.summary: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths.
entries.why: Enables precise camera control and large-angle trajectories for cinematic character video generation.

entries.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
entries.summary: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals.
entries.why: Facilitates data-free self-improvement in foundation models without relying on external teachers or human datasets.

entries.title: Comfy-Org/Fibo-2.0
entries.why: Offers a single-file diffusion model release with notable download activity on Hugging Face.

entries.title: daveebbelaar/bama
entries.summary: BAMA: Build Any Mac App. Agent skills to research, clone, design, build, optimize, and test native macOS apps with Swift and SwiftUI. · Swift
entries.why: Provides agent skills to research, design, build, and test native macOS applications using Swift.

entries.title: JunWan666/astrbot-for-android
entries.summary: 在 Android 手机上本地部署和管理 AstrBot 与 NapCat，内置 PRoot Ubuntu 运行环境，支持原生管理界面、WebUI、日志、备份恢复和独立更新，无需 Root。 · Kotlin
entries.why: Allows local deployment and management of AstrBot and NapCat on Android devices without root access.

entries.title: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: How Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to test user workflows, Daybreak to strengthen security, and Codex to reduce rework.
entries.why: Demonstrates bug detection and user workflow testing advancements using advanced language models.

entries.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
entries.summary: Fanatics uses OpenAI to help fans complete their game-day outfits with Shop the Look. Testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showed 10% higher engagement.
entries.why: Highlights real-world deployment metrics showing increased engagement for sports merchandise shopping features.

entries.title: We tried to automate Epoch
entries.summary: Top models complete about two-thirds of our rubric on real work tasks.
entries.why: Evaluates the capability of top models to complete real work tasks against structured rubrics.

entries.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
entries.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra It's always interesting to note which aspects of a new model are emphasized in the release announcement.
entries.why: Examines release announcements and highlighted features for newly introduced frontier language models.

entries.title: Amazon’s Trainium Takes a Strike at the Training King
entries.summary: Trainium Best for Inference? But now good for Training too, Native Trainium PyTorch, High Quality CI, TorchTitan, GPU Impossible Profiler
entries.why: Analyzes Amazon's Trainium hardware expanding its utility from inference into model training workloads.
